nodes.name: Ni(OH)₂ coating on Pt nanocrystals
nodes.procedure: The long-range Pt-Ni dual sites were successfully prepared by wet-chemical method for the first time. The coated Pt nanoparticles by membrane-like Ni(OH)₂ can be clearly observed. It is noted that, in this work, N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) plays an important role in fabricating successfully Pt-Ni dual sites. In the second step of preparation process, when the mixture of cyclohexane and DMF was replaced by pure cyclohexane, the segregated Pt particles and Ni(OH)₂ nanosheets were obtained. Thus, it can be referred that the treating process can adjust the pH value of the solution to govern the hydrolysis of Ni²⁺ at a certain rate, which can not only avoid the local agglomeration of Ni(OH)₂, but also promote its uniform growth to coat on the Pt particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows concave cubic Pt nanoparticles with uniform dispersion and average diameter of 44.1 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 2(a), the transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image shows that the as-obtained Pt nanoparticles are concave cubic shape with uniform dispersion... average diameter size (apex-to-apex) of Pt nanocrystals is about 44.1 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM reveals bright Pt core and dark Ni(OH)₂ membrane domains in Pt-Ni dual sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF-STEM image (Fig. 2(b))... surrounding dark domains are Ni(OH)₂ membranes (Fig. 2(f)).

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows clear surface steps on Pt particles along [100] zone axis with facets {610}, {510}, {410}, {720}; Pt-Ni dual sites exhibit lattice spacings of 0.196 nm (Pt (200)) and 0.219 nm (Ni(OH)₂·3H₂O (103)).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2(c) exhibits clear surface steps... facet angles are measured approximately 10°, 12°, 14°, and 16°... {610}, {510}, {410}, and {720} facets... lattice distances with interplanar spacings are 0.196 and 0.219 nm, corresponding to the (200) plane of Pt and (103) plane of Ni(OH)₂·3H₂O.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nanoscale elemental mappings show Pt, O, and Ni uniformly dispersed in Pt-Ni dual sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nanoscale element mappings (Figs. 2(g)−2(j)) show that Pt, O, and Ni are uniformly dispersed in Pt-Ni dual sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt shows highly crystalline fcc Pt phase with highest {111} and {200} peaks; Pt-Ni dual sites maintain Pt crystal structure with additional Ni(OH)₂ peaks at 58° and 75°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3(a) shows the XRD patterns of the as-prepared Pt and Pt-Ni dual sites... well-defined Pt particles own a highly crystalline face-centered cubic (fcc) Pt phase... peaks located at 58° and 75° for Pt-Ni dual sites are the typical crystal structure of Ni(OH)₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt 4f XPS shows Pt 4f₇/₂ at 70.72 eV (Pt, metallic) and 71.02 eV (Pt-Ni dual sites, positive shift); Pt²⁺/(Pt⁰ + Pt²⁺) surface content increases from 0.26 (Pt) to 0.43 (Pt-Ni dual sites) due to electron transfer to Ni(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Pt 4f spectra of two catalysts present that the main components of the surface Pt are in the metallic state. The signals of Pt 4f₇/₂ in Pt and Pt-Ni dual sites are 70.72 and 71.02 eV, respectively... the ratio of Pt²⁺/(Pt⁰ + Pt²⁺) increased from the 0.26 to 0.43 (Fig. 3(c)) after introducing the Ni(OH)₂ composite.

nodes.characterization_summary: ECSA values in 0.1 M KOH are 14.6 m²·g⁻¹ (Pt) and 11.9 m²·g⁻¹ (Pt-Ni dual sites).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ECSA values of Pt and Pt-Ni dual sites tested in alkaline media (0.1 M KOH) are about 14.6 and 11.9 m²·g⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: PDOS shows Pt d-band center shifts from -1.86 eV (Pt) to -2.30 eV (Pt-Ni dual sites), favoring water splitting.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 3(d), it is seen that the binding energy of the Pt d-orbital in Pt-Ni dual sites changes from −1.86 to −2.30 eV in comparison with Pt from the plot of the projected d-density of states (PDOSs).
